target.title: fix(agents): align mid-turn tool-result projection precheck
target.body:
Refs #101929

## What Problem This Solves

Mid-turn tool-result precheck estimated the raw in-memory tool-result history, while the next provider prompt path sends the post-truncation projection. When accumulated tool results exceed the live aggregate cap, the mid-turn signal can report route/reducible-char facts from a view that the provider-boundary prompt will not actually send.

This PR now addresses only that projection mismatch. It intentionally keeps the existing conservative 2 chars/token tool-result density policy for the normal pre-prompt estimator.

## Why This Change Was Made

The mid-turn precheck now projects messages through `resolveLiveToolResultAggregateMaxChars` and `truncateOversizedToolResultsInMessages` before calling `shouldPreemptivelyCompactBeforePrompt`, using the same context-window-based aggregate cap as the provider prompt path. The global `estimateLlmBoundaryTokenPressure` tool-result density behavior is unchanged.

Risk note: this touches session-state context routing, so the tests cover the structured mid-turn signal, the aggregate-over-cap projection case, and the lower-budget overflow case where the signal must still fire.

## User Impact

Tool-heavy agent sessions with history above the provider-boundary tool-result aggregate cap should get mid-turn routing based on the same bounded prompt view used for the next model call. This does not relax token-density safety for ordinary pre-prompt compaction decisions or for tool-result histories below the projection cap.

## Evidence

Source/dependency checks:
- Current OpenClaw source check: the pre-prompt/provider prompt path already calls `truncateOversizedToolResultsInMessages` before model submission, while the mid-turn precheck previously estimated the raw post-tool transcript.
- OpenAI Codex dependency source checked locally: `codex-rs/codex-api/src/common.rs:209`, `codex-rs/codex-api/src/common.rs:232`, `codex-rs/codex-api/src/endpoint/responses_websocket.rs:811`, and `codex-rs/core/src/client.rs:822`, `codex-rs/core/src/client.rs:1178`, `codex-rs/core/src/client.rs:1525`, `codex-rs/core/src/client.rs:1582`. The request builders serialize the supplied input/messages and preserve websocket request fields; there is no hidden expansion that would make the mid-turn raw transcript a better estimator than OpenClaw's provider-boundary projection.

Focused validation:
```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/preemptive-compaction.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/tool-result-context-guard.test.ts
Test Files  2 passed (2)
Tests  69 passed (69)
```

```text
./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/preemptive-compaction.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/preemptive-compaction.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/tool-result-context-guard.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/tool-result-context-guard.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

git diff --check
# passed
```

Review:
```text
.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --base upstream/main --output /tmp/openclaw-101952-autoreview.txt --json-output /tmp/openclaw-101952-autoreview.json
autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported
overall: patch is correct (0.78)
```

Live behavior proof:
```text
OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH=<temp>/openclaw.json pnpm openclaw agent --local --json --agent main --session-id issue-101952-live-proof-1783490444 --model deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash --thinking off
OpenClaw 2026.6.11 (b134543)
config: contextTokens=80000; toolResultMaxChars=30000; reserveTokens=0; reserveTokensFloor=0; midTurnPrecheck.enabled=true; aggregateCapChars=160000
requested: 7 turns x 25,000 chars through the real exec tool; persisted session: 8 exec tool results after the mid-turn retry, total tool-result chars 200,480
[agent/embedded] [context-overflow-midturn-precheck] sessionKey=agent:main:explicit:issue-101952-live-proof-1783490444 provider=deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash route=compact_only estimatedPromptTokens=86486 promptBudgetBeforeReserve=80000 overflowTokens=6486 toolResultReducibleChars=0 effectiveReserveTokens=0 prePromptMessageCount=16 sessionFile=<redacted-user-state>/issue-101952-live-proof-1783490444.jsonl
finalAssistantVisibleText: OPENCLAW_101952_SEGMENT_5_DONE
finalAssistantVisibleText: OPENCLAW_101952_SEGMENT_6_DONE
finalAssistantVisibleText: OPENCLAW_101952_SEGMENT_7_DONE
```

The live proof used the real CLI, real DeepSeek provider transport, and real exec tool results. The important regression signal is the mid-turn route computed from the projected provider-boundary view: even after the tool-result projection there is still overflow, but `toolResultReducibleChars=0`, so the route is `compact_only` rather than a raw-history truncation route.

What was not tested:
- I did not rerun the original live OpenAI/Codex OAuth scenario after narrowing this PR to projection alignment only.
- The separate question of relaxing the global tool-result density estimator is intentionally left out of this PR and would need provider/tokenizer evidence plus token-dense plain-text/JSON negative controls.

AI-assisted: implementation and validation were AI-assisted; focused validation commands were run locally.
